title: Delhi nightclub horror: Guest spills beer on woman, bouncers beat him to death with liquor bottles - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
A 29-year-old man died after he was allegedly beaten up by bouncers and staff at a nightclub in northwest Delhi late on Saturday, TOI reported, citing police sources. The incident occurred in the area under the Sarai Rohilla police station.
Police have arrested some people in connection with the case and are trying to identify and apprehend the remaining accused, the report said.
Investigators have seized the nightclub’s CCTV digital video recorder, according to the report. Police are examining the footage to establish the sequence of events and identify those involved, it added.
The deceased was identified as Daljeet, a resident of Raghuvir Nagar. As per the report, he is survived by his wife, his eight-year-old son and his father.
Police sources said Daljeet had gone to the nightclub with a group of friends. An argument broke out after one of them spilled beer on a woman, they said.
The club’s bouncers allegedly assaulted Daljeet and his friends, the report said. The attack reportedly continued even after the group apologised. The situation worsened when waiters allegedly joined in. Daljeet and his friends were allegedly beaten with sticks and glass bottles.
When the group tried to flee, the attackers allegedly dragged them back inside and assaulted them again, according to the report. Daljeet suffered the most serious injuries.
His friends took him to his home in Raghuvir Nagar, where he collapsed near the entrance, the report added. He was rushed to Guru Gobind Singh Hospital, where doctors declared him dead.
